offers_products.reason: Sells AI software: Infosentience text generation, Cutter Studios video tool with paid plans, and Encore monetization engine.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from software tools and ad-funded content, not work done for customers; platform support is secondary.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual creators, and readers of its consumer media brands, buy subscriptions and plans.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers, publishers and media brands buy ad inventory, Cutter plans with SSO and API, and the platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing advertising demand, subscriptions and tiered monthly software plans repeat.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are cut quickly in downturns, and creator tool plans are discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent software subscriptions and ad purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for AI software and platform technology and for content, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual creators, small publishers and media brands, plus programmatic advertisers.

asset_heavy.reason: Digital software and media platform needing no plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Company is shifting from ad-funded publishing (Arena Group brands) to the Paradium.AI platform; the revenue mix is uncertain.
